scope: Offline primary-readiness repair for issue #147, authorized by operator Do it; separate from held C9 stack.

root_cause.status: Confirmed by deterministic public overlap regression; historical Windows scheduling interleaving was not observed directly
root_cause.invariant: Only an actual primary may make readiness probes report a live owner. Concurrent probes must not impersonate it.
root_cause.historical_symptom: Windows startup test reported desktop inherited departed primary readiness; exact OS interleaving remains unobserved.
root_cause.defect: A successful exclusive absence probe remains locked until its File is dropped; another probe can interpret its contention as a primary.

required_change_surface: lifecycle.rs probe operation and deterministic overlap tests using the same production operation and actual Store/StoreAccess readers
Keep actual primary acquisition exclusive; initialization gate excludes probe overlap during acquisition
Record reproduction and adjacent lifecycle/startup/access proof in durable evidence
explicit_non_scope: No model calls, C9 writer or qualification changes
No DB migration, schema, dependency, public API, timeout or retry changes
No assertion weakening, suppression of OCR recovery or serialization of all readiness consumers
Issue #140 is separate unless demonstrated to share the root owner
assumptions_blockers: A deterministic overlap reproduces the same failure class; Windows CI must validate native lock semantics and original startup tests
Contract authorizes repair only if origin is confirmed; otherwise continue isolation
verification_plan: Extract the current operation without behavior changes so a test can retain its File at the real overlap point
Fail-first public regression: while the first real absence probe is held, another StoreAccess.get must reject a departed primary
Passing-after regression; live-primary positive and absent-primary mixed reader/writer/attach checks
Adjacent lifecycle, desktop_startup and StoreAccess tests; formatting; strict all-target/all-feature Clippy
Native Windows lifecycle/startup/access CI, independent exact-head review before merge

implementation_summary.production: Extract one probe operation for deterministic interleaving and change its absence lock to shared; bootstrap primary acquisition remains exclusive under exclusive initialization gate.
implementation_summary.removed_special_cases: None: all readiness consumers already route through require_primary. No downstream workaround was added.
implementation_summary.rework: The exclusive probe was introduced by our earlier storage change 2819d1e7; 978672a7 only changed the absence error.

cold_diff_audit.actual_change: Shared absence probe; error propagation preserved; actual primary acquisition and all consumer callers unchanged.
cold_diff_audit.coverage: Deterministic overlap fails through StoreAccess.get before the lock-mode fix; passes after. Real reader/writer/attach reject absence during overlap. Live-primary positive and original startup assertion pass.

cold_diff_audit.actual_change: Record scope, origin, proof and remaining external gates.

remaining: Independent exact-head review; existing production/merge holds remain
gap_audit.local_evidence: Fail-first: 0 passed, 1 failed at desktop inherited departed primary readiness from another probe (exit 101); passing-after: 1 passed; adjacent db: 35 passed; desktop_startup: 3 passed; formatting passed; strict all-target/all-feature Clippy passed.
